Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL solution from 7 of 11 Cepheids with P>20 d; shorter-period stars were excluded for incompleteness. Hill et al. calibration and R_V=3.3 were adopted. No metallicity correction enters this modulus.

Alternative solution obtained by applying the standard Key Project PL fit to the original Tanvir et al. photometry. It uses seven long-period Cepheids and is not the paper's preferred ALLFRAME distance.
Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL fit to 17 of 36 Cepheids with P>25 d. Dust, bright background and anomalous aperture corrections motivated a 0.15 mag photometric random term, producing the relatively large e_R.

Alternative Key Project fit to Saha et al. photometry. Four outliers were removed from their 25-star final set, leaving 21 Cepheids; the unweighted mean of the individual dereddened moduli was adopted.
Values based on Turner et al. (1998).They apply metallicity correction but just for Ho, not modulus

Alternative Key Project fit to the original Saha et al. photometry, using the article's stated 44-Cepheid P>18 d sample. This shorter cutoff is more susceptible to incompleteness than the preferred P>25 d fit.

Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL solution from 51 of 94 Cepheids with P>25 d, selected to reduce incompleteness bias. It agrees with the earlier Saha et al. distance; no metallicity correction enters the tabulated modulus.
Alternative fit to Saha et al. photometry using 17 high-quality Cepheids on chips 1, 3 and 4. Chip 2 was excluded because its modulus was 0.66 mag larger; including it would give mu0=31.03+/-0.11.

Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL solution. The PL fit uses 27 of 39 candidates with P>20 d to limit incompleteness. All four WFPC2 chips are included because this reduction shows no significant chip-dependent offset.
